LanguageData.RUT_MigrationDesc: A herd of animals is passing through the area.

LanguageData.RUT_ThanksgivingDesc: Word of your colony's hunger has reached a nearby clan. They have sent food as a gesture of goodwill.
LanguageData.RUT_TribalAidDesc: An escape pod has crashed nearby, carrying a wounded traveler in need of aid.
LanguageData.RUT_InsectsDesc: A swarm of hungry insects has emerged nearby and is attacking.
LanguageData.RUT_StrokeDesc: {PAWN_label} has suffered a stroke and collapsed.
LanguageData.RUT_CargoRainDesc: Wreckage from a broken ship has rained down nearby -- salvageable cargo, a wounded survivor, and a body.
